title: Waffles end up thin and crispy
text: Waffles end up thin and crispy. This is fine and cute but the lid is heavy and really squishes the waffles thin. The temperature has to constantly be adjusted so the waffles don’t become crispy. I’m not a big fan of this machine and regret buying it.
